title: My AI Thinks I'm Eating My Feelings (and Other Nutritional Insights) - Rami Alhamad
talk_summary: A consumer nutrition app founder shares product lessons from eight months of building an LLM-powered tracking companion: constrain LLMs to narrow tasks, stream multi-step pipelines to the client, accumulate per-user context, and rely on in-the-moment user feedback over evals. It is mostly product/UX advice with little on agent orchestration, cost, or review quality.

takeaways.technique: Decompose open-ended LLM tasks into narrow constrained steps
takeaways.what_they_do: Instead of one large open-ended LLM call, they split the post-tracking pipeline into discrete modules (e.g., food-item extraction, then USDA database matching) so each LLM step has a small, specific job.
takeaways.evidence_quote: if you give them an open-ended uh very large task uh the error rates are just going to be through the roof

takeaways.technique: Stream partial results per pipeline step
takeaways.what_they_do: Each pipeline stage pushes its partial output to the client as soon as it completes rather than waiting for the full chain, making the experience feel faster and letting downstream steps run concurrently.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we actually broke up the process of how we relay the information uh back to the user after every single time they track

takeaways.technique: In-the-moment thumbs feedback over offline evals
takeaways.what_they_do: They show a 'How did Alma do?' toast after every interaction and use that real-time signal to measure accuracy and guide development, treating formal evals as secondary.
takeaways.evidence_quote: nothing beats real time in the moment feedback from your users

takeaways.technique: Accumulate novel facts into a per-entity knowledge store
takeaways.what_they_do: On each interaction they extract novel information and append it to a persistent 'about you' knowledge set that the model reads on future turns, user-viewable and deletable.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we actually take whatever piece of information if it's novel and we add it to our knowledge data set about you
